about: Throne smart restrooms (Throne Labs) in the coverage box: a hand list, each unit cited. scripts/build_water_restrooms.py merges the units with status 'open' into water-restrooms.json; 'unverified' and 'opens soon' stay here until someone confirms them. Positions are the US Census Bureau geocoder's point for the street address the source gives (geocoding.geo.census.gov, benchmark Public_AR_Current, read 2026-10-11), so they are the site, not the exact unit: within about 500 ft (150 m). Never copied from Google Maps. See frontend/src/amenity-data/README.md.

units.name: Throne, Dupont Circle
units.placement: Census geocoder point for 1 Dupont Cir NW, on the circle; the sources name the circle, not the spot on it.

sources.says: Dupont Circle NW, one of six DC Thrones installed April to June 2024; all six closed 2025-07-30.
Six DC Thrones back in operation (2025-08-05), near Dupont Circle and the National Mall; FY2026 budget funds up to 10.

units.name: Throne, Columbia Heights Civic Plaza
units.placement: Census geocoder point for 3100 14th St NW, beside the plaza at 14th St and Park Rd NW.

sources.says: Columbia Heights Plaza NW, inaugurated 2024-06-06.
Columbia Heights Plaza among the six; funding found to keep them running (2025-07-10).

units.name: Throne, Indiana Plaza by DC Superior Court
units.placement: Census geocoder point for 500 Indiana Ave NW, DC Superior Court.

sources.says: Outside D.C. Superior Court, the busiest of the six (18,832 uses by 2025-05-22).
Indiana Plaza, downtown NW.

units.name: Throne, Alethia Tanner Park

sources.says: Alethia Tanner Park NE, one of the six.
Park address 227 Harry Thomas Way NE.

sources.says: Oxon Run Park SE, one of the six.
Oxon Run playground at Mississippi Ave and 6th St SE.
